news.title: SpaceX拟在IPO后以600亿美元收购AI编程初创公司Cursor
news.snippet: SpaceX计划在IPO后以600亿美元收购AI编程初创公司Cursor。
news.raw_snippet: SpaceX plans to acquire AI coding startup Cursor for $60 billion roughly 30 days after its IPO, which is expected to list on Nasdaq on 12 June at a $1.75 trillion valuation. The deal includes a $10 billion breakup fee and would fold one of the fastest-growing startups in history into Elon Musk’s expanding SpaceX-xAI empire.*. SpaceX expects to complete its $60 billion acquisition of AI coding startup Cursor roughly 30 days after it begins trading publicly, according to Bloomberg, a timeline that would place the deal in July if the company’s blockbuster IPO proceeds on schedule. SpaceX is seeking to raise $75 billion at a valuation of roughly $1.75 trillion, which would make it the largest stock-market debut in history, eclipsing Saudi Aramco’s $29.4 billion offering in 2019. SpaceX completed its merger with xAI, Musk’s artificial intelligence company and the parent of social media platform X, in February 2026 in an all-stock transaction that valued the combined entity at $1.25 trillion.

news.title: 重塑AI：NextEra Energy引爆巨型并购
news.snippet: 人工智能巨大的能源需求推动NextEra Energy发起重大并购，重塑能源与AI基础设施格局。
news.raw_snippet: The insatiable energy demand of artificial intelligence represents a structural shift in the global economy. NextEra Energy’s agreement to acquire Dominion Energy Inc. in a $67 billion all-stock transaction represents a response to this reality. By absorbing Dominion Energy’s grid, NextEra Energy positions itself as the indispensable energy backbone for massive technology platforms. The market’s initial reaction was a dip in NextEra Energy’s stock price on heavy volume, while Dominion Energy rose nearly 10%. The strategic crown jewel of this transaction is Dominion Energy’s monopolistic control over the grid servicing the largest concentration of data centers on the planet. Under the terms of the agreement, Dominion Energy shareholders will receive a fixed exchange ratio of 0.8138 NextEra Energy shares for each share of Dominion Energy they hold. Based on NextEra Energy’s recent price action, the exchange ratio implies a value of roughly $72 per Dominion Energy share, creating an arbitrage spread that reflects the market’s pricing of regulatory risk and the 12 to 18-month closing timeline.

Google DeepMind has reached a deal to hire more than 20 researchers from artificial intelligence startup Contextual AI and license its technology, according to people familiar with the matter. The Alphabet Inc.-owned research lab has agreed to pay roughly $100 million to Contextual as part of the arrangement, said the people, who spoke on condition of anonymity as the information is not public. Among those joining DeepMind is Douwe Kiela, Contextual’s co-founder and chief executive officer, the people said.
